name: MDS Core Datasets
description: CMS Minimum Data Set (MDS) 3.0 Core Datasets contain standardized resident assessment data collected for Medicare- and Medicaid-certified nursing facilities. Products include beneficiary denominator and stay-level files that support cohort construction, nursing home utilization studies, transitions-of-care research, and linkage with other health datasets.

license.name: No license. DUA required for access.
